verdict.rationale: A registered agent service could plausibly offer an API or other documented machine interface for retrieving received legal documents and their metadata, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no first-party documentation: the probe was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge at robots.txt, and the only community item is unrelated. With no evidence of a machine interface beyond a dashboard, the verdict is none, and confidence is low because the first-party corpus could not be fetched.
